verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at unit.co/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its quoted contents are high-level product overviews (accounts, payments, cards, lending, bank partners) rather than API reference material an agent could build against. Probes for markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. missing for 10: API-level content in llms.txt, markdown versions of the API docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent usability.
